question: Dr DS Athwal was known as the 'Father of __________ Revolution in India'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. D.S. Athwal **had a hand in creating **"PV 18" in 1966 **and** "Kalyansona",** the most well-known amber-grained wheat variety, in **1967**.
 
• **Kalyansona** was named for the **Punjabi village of "Kalyanpur"** where Athwal was born in 1928.
 
• **Dilbagh Singh Athwal** is an agricultural scientist who is often called the** "Father of Wheat Revolution".**
 
• He became a member of the management team of the **International Rice Research Institute in 1967** and eventually held the position of first deputy director general.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **M.S. Swaminathan**, the renowned agricultural scientist, is referred to as the **"Father of the Green Revolution"**.
